name: io.github.kaelorlabs/smitline
title: Smitline
description: Make phone calls and join Zoom, Teams and Google Meet meetings from any AI agent. Self-hosted.

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: Serves the console and MCP on 127.0.0.1:8095 and reaches the phone provider. On Docker Desktop, turn on host networking first.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Keeps your keys, settings, and call history in the smitline volume.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Needed for meetings only: Smitline starts a meeting container for each meeting. This gives it control of Docker; leave it out for phone calls only.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Smitline's local MCP token. Print it with: docker exec smitline smitline setup register --json

smitline_token.description: The token from docker exec smitline smitline setup register --json
